verdict.rationale: Supermemory's docs list an official CLI among its coding-agent tooling (`npx supermemory setup`, which detects the project and launches or prints an integration flow). However, the only documented use is integration setup, not day-to-day memory work from the terminal. missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands for adding/searching/managing memories, a CLI reference with flags and auth handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
